svg.desc: Native KiCad geometry, 2975050c28c89fc96bf781cf082bffffc84189e6720ce05c4200d8552ac298fc. 116/116 candidate FPGA nets copper-connected, with one external analog reservation and 0 assigned-net gaps. Electrical and timing verification remain open; not manufacturing release.
